title: The Last Spire
author: Theo Reyes
blurb: Gideon Blackwood, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
